nom: DERMA E Anti-Wrinkle Cleanser with Retinol

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers generally say the cleanser controls oil and does not over-dry, though one notes it 'might not be quite enough' if skin is really oily.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or well-balanced skin describe it as gentle and non-stripping, calling it a favorite for that skin type.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report a good moisture/clean balance, including in a desert climate, with no dryness or tightness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and a non-stripping feel, but one sensitive-skin reviewer avoided repurchase due to a strong soap-like scent.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal skin report light, bubbly texture and no breakouts, using it alongside anti-aging routines.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s-50s) report soft, clean skin but mixed results on visible wrinkle reduction, from 'no change' to 'wrinkles improved.'

concerns.aging: Several mature reviewers say fine lines/wrinkles look improved or skin appears more radiant over time; others explicitly say they saw no change to wrinkles or fine lines despite regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not dry out or strip skin, feeling soft and moisturized after use; however, one reviewer with oily/combination skin reports it made her skin dry and flaky.
concerns.redness: One reviewer notes skin is not left red or tight after use; no other redness complaints are mentioned.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers broadly report a non-stripping, moisture-balanced cleanse; no barrier-damage complaints beyond the isolated dryness/flaking report.
concerns.spots: Not enough specific mentions of spots/dark marks to characterize.
concerns.blemishes: One young reviewer with acne says it helps significantly and keeps skin soft; no dissenting reports on breakouts are present, and one reviewer specifically confirms it does not break her out.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced oil throughout the day and a mattifying effect, though one notes it may be insufficient for very oily skin.

aspects.libelle: Pump dispenses good amount, easy to use

extraits.texte: I had high hopes for this cleanser but, unfortunately, I have noticed how dry and flakey my skin has become. (I normally have oily/combination skin). I had to go back to my former cleanser in hopes it will repair my skin. Still on the lookout for a good cleanser with clean ingredients.

I like this product. It washes really well and it doesn't irritate my skin at all. The only thing is that it doesn't have a ton of lather lol and I actually prefer more lather. But it has retinol in it so take away my wrinkles lol

I've been using this product for years. I have oily skin and this works very well to keep oil from forming throughout the day. I use a maybe half a pump twice a day. I like how it's not overly foaming. The ingredients is what drove me to this product.
I'm 22 and I've been using this face wash for over a year now, it helps so much with my acne and keeps my skin so soft

extraits.titre: My favorite gel-cleanser from Derma E
extraits.texte: We used to use the anti-wrinkle scrub, which we liked, but have been trying to move away from physical exfoliants. This was a great alternative and our new Derma E favorite. Great for our sensitive skin and has helped keep our skin clear. Pleasant light scent. Non-stripping. No complaints!

This stuff is so gentle and leaves my face so soft, that I ended up buying a second one for the shower so I don't have to move it back and forth from the sink. This is perfect if you you have dry or well-balanced skin. It might not be quite enough if you've got really oily skin, but I have nothing but love for this stuff!

My skin feels great after using this cleanser. It does a light daily exfoliation without stripping my skin of moisture. I live in the desert and this gives my combo skin the perfect blend of moisture, clean, and exfoliation. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
